Pocket is a small device that takes notes for all your conversations and meetings. Later, Pocket sends you transcripts, summaries and pulls out your to-dos.\
\
Pocket is taking off. In the last 5 months, we’ve delivered over 30,000 units. **We have a $27M annualized revenue run rate, growing 50% month over month.**

<https://youtu.be/VpNJNPkbsIs>\
\

We kept noticing the same thing: every important conversation in our lives happened in person - investor meetings, doctor visits, client calls, team standups. And every single note-taking tool on the planet only worked over Zoom.

For in-person conversations, the best technology available was a pen.

**So we built Pocket.**

Pocket is a small device. **Three mics. One button.**

You press it. You have your conversation. **A summary is waiting for you in the Pocket app.**

The full transcript too. Pocket tacks who said what. You get automatically-generated summaries. And those things you promised? **We capture all your todos for you.**

With Pocket, **you don't type. You don't take notes. You can just talk and be present.**\
\
**It also does something no app can:**

Snap Pocket to the back of your phone. **Its contact mic can capture and summarize both sides of a phone call. No speakerphone required.**

Your doctor calls with test results? Someone rattles off an interesting quote? Your lawyer explains something complicated and fast? **It's all in Pocket. Word for word.**

Hi everyone, we’re [Marie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marie-schneegans/) and [Michae](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michaelfester/)l, and we’re building [14.ai](http://14.ai): the AI-native customer service agency. Our customers include AI glasses company Brilliant, men’s health supplement company Sperm Worms, Nordic lighting company Creative Lighting, and luxury skincare brand Yon-Ka. Michael previously co-founded Snips, an AI voice platform acquired by Sonos.

**The problem: the death loop of customer service**

We’ve all been there: you have a simple problem that you take to customer support, but you’re forced into a never-ending cycle of being passed between different agents and explaining your situation for the (n + 1)th time.

**1. The burden of effort:** If a customer is working harder than the company to solve a problem, the system has failed.

**2. Fragmentation:** You start a chat on your phone, move to your desktop, and have to explain your account number and issue for the third time.

**3. Dumb automation:** You talk with a chatbot that acts as a gatekeeper, not a helper.

**4. Costly, slow onboarding:** Onboarding a new customer support agent brings an expensive and time-consuming burden.

Traditional BPOs (Business Process Outsourcing) try to solve this through headcount in low-cost regions, and rely on manual processes and legacy CRMs that are slow to adapt and prone to error. This approach does not work.

### **The solution: [14.ai](http://14.ai) is the AI-native customer service agency**

We are a full-service agency built from the ground up with AI as the core engine.

#### **1. High-touch concierge**

Excellent service guides everything we do. After our customers hand over their existing integrations, we tell them to stop answering tickets; now, it’s our problem. This level of service extends to our customer’s customers. We offer the best customer service in the world, and we are always working to stay that way.

#### **2. Low constant onboarding**

[14.ai](http://14.ai) goes live within hours. We take away the burden of onboarding new customer support agents and begin answering your tickets immediately. We get our customers to inbox zero on day zero.

#### **3. Agentic resolution**

Most bots just provide “how-to” links. [14.ai](http://14.ai) actually does the work. We plug in to your company’s most complex processes, autonomously verifying purchases, generating shipping labels, and triggering refunds in a single, seamless flow.

#### **4. Outcomes, not tools**

Our AI engineers operate our own highly tailored software for automation. Customers only see the parts they actually need to see: reports, CX metrics, resolved conversations, VIP or high-touch integrations, and the like.

#### **5. The human-AI feedback loop**

Our human team is supercharged, not replaced. We also service our customers around the clock, 24/7.

Our full-time AI engineers are based in San Francisco and are responsible for answering every support ticket, automated or not. Every time we encounter an edge case, that intervention is fed back into our agents - they become smarter every day.

### **Who is this for?**

**E-commerce companies, mobile applications, fintech companies, healthcare companies, and more.** These are types of companies we’ve worked with already and have seen huge impact with. Customer relationships begin with a 7-day free trial, allowing for onboarding and for potential customers to confirm that there is a fit.

Every customer we have onboarded repurposed their support teams before their trial even finished.

We thrive where volume is high and customer support is managed by a number of human customer support agents, either domestically or overseas. If you’re a company with a backlog of support tickets, even better: we’ll take care of your entire backlog on Day 1.

### **Our ask**

We want to be your customer service. If you’re tired of managing a fragmented support team, fighting with legacy BPOs and VAs, or having a backlog of support tickets, we’d love to talk.

**Visit our website at[ ](https://14.ai)[14.ai](http://14.ai) or book an intro call with us here.**

### **Also! We’re launching the world’s first autonomous consumer brand: GloGlo**

[GloGlo](https://gloglo.com/) are rapid glucose gummies designed for Type 1 diabetics, high-performance athletes, and more. They are built to deliver rapid and reliable carbohydrates, meeting quality-of-life pain points that glucose tablets don’t address and elevating the consumption experience from existing options. The brand is powered by [14.ai](http://14.ai), meaning we are owning and operating GloGlo from the ground up. GloGlo is a blueprint for how B2C companies can operate at a world-class level autonomously, while delivering the best possible customer experience. Check it out at [gloglo.com](http://gloglo.com).

launches.title: Mocke, Cold Email AI Agent
launches.tagline: Cursor for cold email, with lead research and personalization at scale
launches.detail_body:
Hey, it's Matt here. Really excited to launch Mocke today, because it has been a wow moment for ourselves and beta users. Can't wait to share it with everyone who writes cold email.

# TLDR;

Mocke is an AI agent for cold email. It works like Cursor for development. Mocke collapses hours of cold email writing into seconds and conducts deep research on each lead to deliver completely personalized messaging at scale.

Try Mocke here <https://mocke.co/>. No account is needed; just enter your website to see the cold email you are going to love in 60 seconds.

# **The problems we are solving**

### The 0.1 → 1 Problem

Even though everyone now has access to ChatGPT, crafting effective cold emails still requires significant time and effort. Here's the typical experience of someone writing cold emails:

1. ChatGPT provides a first draft in 5 seconds, which looks decent.
2. The user then spends time refining the phrases, CTA, subject line, messaging, and final touches. This process can take an hour or even several hours until they feel comfortable sending out the emails.

The challenge is rather the effort needed to refine the draft for production, because no one feels comfortable taking the 1st drafted email from ChatGPT and send to real leads. Therefore, I refer to this problem as the 0.1 to 1 problem.

### The personalization with deep research

ChatGPT is a commodity that everyone already has access to. So, writing a good cold email is no longer sufficient to get meaningful returns from campaigns. Relevance has already become the #1 indicator for a high reply rate. However, there are no effective tools available for conducting in-depth research on each lead and crafting personalized, unique emails for every individual.

In the market, many AI sales tools attempt to build rapport in cold emails by referencing LinkedIn activities, such as congratulating someone on a promotion or mentioning a recent post. However, leads can quickly recognize poorly generated personalization in these outreach efforts, which often lack genuine relevance. This undermines trust and reduces interest.

# **The solution - Mocke: your cold email AI agent**

Mocke is a Cold Email AI agent that functions like Cursor. It reduces hours of cold email writing and deep personalization to just 60 seconds, delivering thousands of unique email messages that leads will love instantly. While it works alongside you, the AI agent handles most of the ideation, writing, polishing, personalization, and deep research, allowing you to achieve results without lifting a finger.

### Step 1: Campaign idea

Mocke suggests campaign ideas. By simply entering your website, the AI agent identifies the ideal ICP, highlights the most suitable pain points for cold emailing (as not every pain point is effective for cold emailing), and provides a creative messaging angle designed to attract a lot of responses.

You can start not only with your website but also with your inbound website visitors, conference pre- and post-outreach, publishing a new case study, creating a new blog post, promoting a new AI feature, and more. Share any of these with Mocke, and the AI agent will develop a comprehensive outbound strategy for you.

Below is a basic example using [@Pylon](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/28069)’s website. (big fan of their product btw!)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/216b3b61-dd14-41ca-9838-5acb958e8d04)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/1595b949-d321-4eff-b84b-361df55b3934)

### Step 2: Email template

Mocke writes email templates with embedded prompts. Refer to the Pylon example below.

For each email, AI agent may propose an engaging subject line, a creative value-based call to action (beyond a simple meeting request), and crucially, instructions for conducting deep research and personalization, presented as prompts in **\[square brackets\]**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/dcad9216-12af-4494-ba86-d82f4cb52fee)

What Mocke will do is to run deep research into a lead, the business behind, their department and teams, and all relevant information with regard to what AI agent is selling. Then with the targeted deep research, AI agent will generate a highly-relevant email for one lead.

 Just to highlight, in the Pylon example above, there are various prompts:

* A paragraph prompt `[Write a short paragraph in 30 words or less. Ask the lead if their support team has experienced a large volume of support tickets in Q1 2026, and how they handle it. Must mention one specific technical product error message often asked by the lead's users. Must use deep technical terminology in the context of the lead's product. Must mention the lead's product name.]`
* A phrase prompt `[describe the lead's team, in 3 words or less]`

 So you can choose from full delegation to AI to write content, or partially if you want to have finer control over customization.

###  Step 3: Preview deep research and emails

To review the deep research and email writing, you can provide a lead's LinkedIn profile for the AI agent to conduct in-depth research and craft a personalized email in real-time. This ensures you feel confident about the dynamic content generated by the AI, based on the prompts embedded in the email templates.

 For this demo, I'm again using two potential leads of Pylon and have AI run deep research to write emails. You can compare them side-to-side to see the difference.

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/4d2f6ca8-bda6-4264-bab1-295e51ba50c4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98226&key=user_uploads/675671/d773b48d-0501-4b35-83df-cb2364a6b508)

### Ready to launch

After completing the three steps in just 60 seconds, you can upload your list of leads. The AI agent will then conduct deep research and create personalized messages for each lead, one by one!

# 🚀🚀🚀 **Ask**

No sign-up is required, and it's free to use. Simply visit our website <https://mocke.co/> and enter your website. In just 60 seconds, you'll receive a cold email that you'll truly like.

My ask: try it out with your website and share your honest feedback. Let us know  whether you love it or not.

 

---

---

---

---

---

— — — —

---

# How it works underneath

If you are still reading and interested to know a little more.

### Email Writing Workflow

For each lead, Mocke would go through a few steps to write unique messaging per person and ensure it's relevant.

1. Build a profile of the lead by scraping LinkedIn page
2. Build a profile of the company of the lead by querying B2B databases
3. Use [@Firecrawl](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/27152) (shout out to the team, amazing product as well!) to crawl website and/or targeted information search using its agent
4. Use agentic loop to finish email writing, polishing, reviewing, scoring, and delivering

### What can be found in deep research?

1. Anything mentioned on main marketing website
2. Anything mentioned in documentation
3. Google searchable content if the results come back in the first page of SERP
4. Top reddit relevant threads (same reason as above, indexed by Google)
5. Personal and company LinkedIn profiles activities

### What if AI can't find information?

Mocke AI agent will not generate inaccurate information, as we have safeguards in place. In the case of information not found, AI will write generic content, rather than specific reference of information.

launches.title: nCompass - Optimize performance on GPUs, 10x faster
launches.tagline: Automate performance optimization at all levels of the AI infrastructure stack
launches.detail_body:
Hey everyone,

**tldr;**

I’m Aditya, co-founder of [nCompass Technologies](https://ncompass.tech). We’re building a developer tool that unifies profiling, trace collaboration and trace analysis of AI systems. We automate performance optimization of AI systems across all levels of the infrastructure stack.

Using this tool, we implemented a Hopper GEMM kernel that outperformed NVIDIA's CUTLASS GEMMs by 3%, within a day - this took us months before.

Checkout our product demo below. It’s free to use and you can get started today in **VS Code, Cursor or Claude Code** - [Quick Start](https://docs.ncompass.tech/quick-start)

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q3Pq-BPU2Ec>

**THE PROBLEM**

Identifying the root cause of performance bottlenecks is 4-8x slower than writing the code to fix them.

If you are optimizing a system like vLLM, you have to:

* Run a profile and then copy a giant trace file to your local machine just to view it.
* Spend hours identifying opportunities for performance improvement.
* If this involves writing a kernel, you profile the kernel, spend hours or days digging through ncu traces that are massive data dumps.
* Then you identify your bottlenecks and formulate a plan.

Running this loop till you have a performant system can take weeks, even months.

**OUR SOLUTION**

By building an AI agent that can analyze profiling data as well as interact with a bank of deep technical knowledge and expertise, we’re automating the process of identifying performance bottlenecks.

Now in a single VSCode interface, you can:

* Open and view trace files
* Use our novel tools like trace diffs to analyze them
* Generate share links to easily share traces with team members
* Feed source + profiling data to our AI agent and get back actionable analysis on how you can optimize the performance of your system.

This applies to both systems and GPU kernel level analysis and our agent integrates directly into Cursor / Claude Code, so you never have to leave your normal workflow!

**Anyone** can now write both correct and performant code with AI!

**ASKS**

**Install our VSCode extension** and start optimizing your systems performance!

* [Quick Start](https://docs.ncompass.tech/quick-start)
* [Detailed Docs](https://docs.ncompass.tech)

**We also offer FDE services** - if you would like us to step in and analyze your system’s performance and provide you with an analysis of how much we could improve it by - reach out at [hello@ncompass.tech](https://mailto:hello@ncompass.tech)

launches.title: WarpGrep v2: Code Search Subagent -> #1 on SWE-Bench Pro
launches.tagline: Code search limits coding capabiltiies. Moving it out to a specialized model wins.
launches.detail_body:
### WarpGrep v2 is a fast code search subagent that works via parallel tool calls. Runs up to 36 grep/read tool calls in under 5s.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98329&key=user_uploads/405977/ba17c624-92ca-4502-8c56-00c22e31ad4e)

### SWE-Bench Pro: WarpGrep v2

#### Scores

* Opus 4.6 → 55.4
* GPT-5.3 Codex → 56.0
* MiniMax 2.5 → 55.4
* Opus 4.6 + WarpGrep → **57.5** (**+2.1**)
* Codex 5.3 + WarpGrep → **59.1 (+3.1)**
* MiniMax 2.5 + WarpGrep → **57.6** (**+3.7**)

#### Efficiency

Tokens:

* Input tokens: **\~17% less** (Opus, Codex, MiniMax, etc..)
* Output tokens: **13% less** (fewer turns)

Turns (MiniMax):

* Avg turns per task: **157 → 135**

Runtime (Opus):

* Opus 4.6: **518s**
* Opus 4.6 + WarpGrep: **545s**
* **178s saved** (**12% faster**)

Cost (Opus):

* Opus 4.6: **$3.06**
* Opus 4.6 + WarpGrep: **$2.51**
* **$0.55 saved** (**15.6% cheaper**)

#### TLDR

WarpGrep v2 raises SWE-Bench Pro scores (**+2.1 Opus**, **+3.7 MiniMax**) while using **\~17% fewer input tokens**, **13% fewer turns**, running **12% faster**, and costing **15.6% less**. The median WarpGrep codebase search takes 5s end to end compared to 75s for the Claude Code Explore subagent

On normal usage on production repos these numbers improve across the board \~40% faster

\
install it in your favorite coding agent here <https://www.morphllm.com/mcp>

or integrate it into your product here <https://docs.morphllm.com/sdk/components/warp-grep/tool>

launches.title: Tepali: AI-Native Operating System for Medspas
launches.tagline: All-in-one AI-native platform to run your medspa.
launches.detail_body:
Hey everyone!

We're Vishnu and Chrisvin, the co-founders of Tepali.

**TL;DR**

Tepali is the AI-native operating system for medspas. We replace the disconnected tools every medspa juggles today (marketing, scheduling, payments, charting, inventory, and team management) with a single platform built AI-first.

Ask: Know someone who owns or operates a medspa? We'd love to chat → [founders@tepali.com](mailto:founders@tepali.com)

**The Problem**

Medspas are one of the fastest-growing industries in the U.S., with over 30,000 locations and growing 20%+ annually. Owners are spending more on marketing than ever, but have no idea what's working.

A medspa owner runs a $1,800 HydraFacial campaign on Meta. Nine people walk in. Was that good? What's the cost per acquisition? What's the lifetime value of those patients vs. the ones who came from Google Ads? Today, answering that question means pulling data from your ad platform, your booking system, your POS, and a spreadsheet. And hoping the numbers line up. They never do.

This is the core problem: every medspa runs on disconnected tools that don't talk to each other. Separate systems for booking, charting, payments, marketing, inventory, and team management. Patient data lives in one place, revenue data in another, and marketing data in a third. Owners are flying blind on the decisions that matter most: which campaigns to scale, which patients are churning, which providers are most profitable.

The existing software isn't solving this, and what does exist was architected before the AI era. They've bolted on surface-level chatbots as an afterthought. None of them connect ad spend to patient lifetime value. None of them offer native payroll or accounting. Medspa owners are left filling the gaps themselves.

**Our Solution**

Tepali replaces the current tech stack with a single AI-native platform.

Marketing intelligence: Connect ad spend to patient lifetime value automatically. See which campaigns print money and which ones to cut, without pulling from multiple platforms into spreadsheets.

Patient CRM + smart scheduling: Every patient's full journey from first ad click to VIP member in one profile. Provider-aware booking that matches treatments to qualified staff, with online self-booking, deposit capture, and automated reminders.

Digital charting + inventory: Treatment-specific charts with injection maps, photo documentation, and consent management. Real-time inventory with lot tracking, expiry alerts, and automatic reorder points.

AI assistant: An AI that sits on top of your entire operation and answers any question about your business in seconds. "Which campaigns should I scale?" "Who's available for Botox next Tuesday?" "Which patients are due for re-treatment?"

**The Team**

We've been best friends since middle school and building things together ever since.

Vishnu studied Computer Science at Carnegie Mellon, then built all-in-one operational software for multi-location businesses as a software engineer at Dripos (YC W20) and MealPal, working closely with support and implementations teams to understand the pain of fragmented tech stacks firsthand.

Chrisvin was an Investment Banking Analyst at PJT Partners, where he executed over $30 billion in M&A, restructuring, and strategic advisory across companies like the NFL, Verizon, Goldman Sachs, and Apollo. Before Tepali, he ran Biz Ops at Rilla, where he saw firsthand how AI is transforming high-ticket service industries like HVAC and recognized the same opportunity in medspas.

**Our Ask**

Know a medspa owner? We'd love to chat → [founders@tepali.com](mailto:founders@tepali.com)

Own or operate a medspa? We'd love to show you a demo → [tepali.com](http://tepali.com)

launches.title: Envariant – The control layer for foundation models
launches.tagline: AI interpretability SDK to analyze, steer, and control model behavior
launches.detail_body:
**The Problem**\
Foundation models are powerful but volatile. They hallucinate, drift, and produce brittle outputs that block scientific and engineering workflows.\
\
The standard fixes are expensive, slow, and often destabilizing. They don't scale to the settings that matter most: multi-property, multi-scale tasks like generating new materials or optimizing genetic medicines, where verification itself is difficult, ambiguous, or costly.\
\
Teams end up trapped in "guess and check" loops — iterating on data and retraining instead of reasoning directly about model behavior. Persistent failure modes go undetected, and creative opportunities inside models go unexploited.\
\
**What Envariant Does**\
Envariant moves verification upstream — from the lab directly into the model's latent space. Our SDK exposes a compact set of primitives so you can specify a property and then reliably observe and control it:

* **Detect**, measure, & causally trace properties and behaviors (hallucinations, safety, style, invariants)
* **Reason** inductively, generalize, and steer behavior programmatically
* **Extract** human-readable domain principles the model has learned
* **Synthesize** targeted edge cases to rapidly improve capabilities

No bespoke engineering, heavy orchestration, or massive dataset requirements.\
\
**Results**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98301&key=user_uploads/972303/286868f9-7ff7-43de-95f6-ac0c3675e02e)

We started with failure mode detection: using one underlying primitive, we’ve reached SOTA performance in hallucination detection in text LLMs, real-time degradation detection in robotic VLAs, and antibody-binding prediction. We’re releasing a [beta of this for testing](https://huggingface.co/spaces/var764/envrnt-failure-detection) on March 3rd!

**What’s Next**

We’ll be scaling up our failure mode detection, expanding this to general property detection and measurement, and releasing experiments & SOTA results across inductive reasoning, steering, and principle extraction this week. Long term, we want to remove the bottlenecks to progress by turning mechanistic understanding into actionable capabilities — enabling teams to reliably control behavior and accelerate discovery.

**Our Ask**\
We'd love intros to:

**ML teams in deep tech and safety-critical verticals** — bio, materials science, physics simulation, robotics, autonomous systems, formal reasoning.

**Teams building foundational AI** or sovereign/private-model deployments.

Reach out at [**founders@envariant.ai**](mailto:founders@envariant.ai) or visit [**envariant.ai**](http://envariant.ai).

launches.title: Ashr: Mimic Your Production Environment and Users to Catch Agent Fails
launches.tagline: Custom Tests and Evals Simulating Real User Behavior
launches.detail_body:
Hi YC, we’re Shreyas and Rohan — two ex-Berkeley students building Ashr.

**TL;DR :** Ashr catches bugs and validates agent response quality by mimicking the patterns and quirks of real users. Developers today struggle to simulate these conditions in tests, resulting in real-time fails and unexpected behavior. We integrate as an SDK within your codebase.

<https://youtu.be/O_sTLTk906E>

# The Problem

AI automations are top of mind for every developer: large companies are integrating AI into older systems to stay technologically relevant, while AI-native companies are quickly emerging in every vertical. Unfortunately, most of these AI tools miss the mark: constant hallucinations, unexpected behavior, and dubious quality have eroded trust in agentic systems. In most cases, this is not because foundation models aren’t powerful enough, but because of subtle prompting, tooling, and scaffolding errors that only emerge with rigorous testing. The need for high volumes of realistic testing arises in many scenarios: we’ve spoken to companies who want to prove that their agents are capable of handling sensitive data to potential customers, developers who want to make their agents work better, and engineers who want to test edge-cases and new features but don’t have all the necessary tools.

We’ve seen teams confront this problem with a litany of half-measures: pushing to production and tanking user trust as a means of discovering bugs, half-baked test harnesses, and vibe-coded test suites that only scratch the surface. We built ashr to solve this.

# Our Solution

Ashr is a modular testing and evaluation platform for your agentic system. We integrate as an SDK into your codebase, allowing you to request test suites and analyzing your agents’ output based off your tooling and ideal outputs. These tests mimic how real users utilize an agentic system: taking complex tool call paths, using obscure language with unclear instructions, and attempting to use restricted features. We develop environments, fine-tuned custom scorers, and stop at nothing to provide all the insights needed to bring your agent to a truly production-ready state.

We also work seamlessly with Claude Code and Cursor, allowing your coding agents to quickly prototype and test changes while receiving immediate feedback. Teams have run swarms of agents testing with ashr overnight, and have woken up to changes that reduced hallucinations and increased accuracy and user retention, all without writing a single line of code.

# Our Ask

If you’re building agents, book a call today at [**https://ashr.io/**](https://ashr.io/). **All onboarding is done via call so we can ensure everyone is ready to go and start using as soon as possible.** In addition, we’d love feedback on our docs, opinions about the nature of test infra, and just chatting with a bunch of builders on how to make our product better.

You can reach us at [founders@ashr.io](mailto:founders@ashr.io)

# The Team

**We’re two young founders passionate about changing the world with agentic development**

* **Rohan** built his first startup, an AI-native survey platform for old age homes, as a student at Berkeley, before exiting as part of an acquisition and joining YC.
* **Shreyas** worked on AI-native workflows at Tessera Labs, mentored by a team of ex-Meta and Netflix research, and delivering value in the ERP transformations of Fortune 100 companies.

launches.title: Mocke, Cold Email AI Agent
launches.tagline: Cursor for cold email, with lead research and personalization at scale
launches.detail_body:
Hey, it's Matt here. Really excited to launch Mocke today, because it has been a wow moment for ourselves and beta users. Can't wait to share it with everyone who writes cold email.

# TLDR;

Mocke is an AI agent for cold email. It works like Cursor for development. Mocke collapses hours of cold email writing into seconds and conducts deep research on each lead to deliver completely personalized messaging at scale.

Try Mocke here <https://mocke.co/>. No account is needed; just enter your website to see the cold email you are going to love in 60 seconds.

# **The problems we are solving**

### The 0.1 → 1 Problem

Even though everyone now has access to ChatGPT, crafting effective cold emails still requires significant time and effort. Here's the typical experience of someone writing cold emails:

1. ChatGPT provides a first draft in 5 seconds, which looks decent.
2. The user then spends time refining the phrases, CTA, subject line, messaging, and final touches. This process can take an hour or even several hours until they feel comfortable sending out the emails.

The challenge is rather the effort needed to refine the draft for production, because no one feels comfortable taking the 1st drafted email from ChatGPT and send to real leads. Therefore, I refer to this problem as the 0.1 to 1 problem.

### The personalization with deep research

ChatGPT is a commodity that everyone already has access to. So, writing a good cold email is no longer sufficient to get meaningful returns from campaigns. Relevance has already become the #1 indicator for a high reply rate. However, there are no effective tools available for conducting in-depth research on each lead and crafting personalized, unique emails for every individual.

In the market, many AI sales tools attempt to build rapport in cold emails by referencing LinkedIn activities, such as congratulating someone on a promotion or mentioning a recent post. However, leads can quickly recognize poorly generated personalization in these outreach efforts, which often lack genuine relevance. This undermines trust and reduces interest.

# **The solution - Mocke: your cold email AI agent**

Mocke is a Cold Email AI agent that functions like Cursor. It reduces hours of cold email writing and deep personalization to just 60 seconds, delivering thousands of unique email messages that leads will love instantly. While it works alongside you, the AI agent handles most of the ideation, writing, polishing, personalization, and deep research, allowing you to achieve results without lifting a finger.

### Step 1: Campaign idea

Mocke suggests campaign ideas. By simply entering your website, the AI agent identifies the ideal ICP, highlights the most suitable pain points for cold emailing (as not every pain point is effective for cold emailing), and provides a creative messaging angle designed to attract a lot of responses.

You can start not only with your website but also with your inbound website visitors, conference pre- and post-outreach, publishing a new case study, creating a new blog post, promoting a new AI feature, and more. Share any of these with Mocke, and the AI agent will develop a comprehensive outbound strategy for you.

Below is a basic example using [@Pylon](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/28069)’s website. (big fan of their product btw!)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98225&key=user_uploads/675671/216b3b61-dd14-41ca-9838-5acb958e8d04)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98225&key=user_uploads/675671/1595b949-d321-4eff-b84b-361df55b3934)

### Step 2: Email template

Mocke writes email templates with embedded prompts. Refer to the Pylon example below.

For each email, AI agent may propose an engaging subject line, a creative value-based call to action (beyond a simple meeting request), and crucially, instructions for conducting deep research and personalization, presented as prompts in **\[square brackets\]**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98225&key=user_uploads/675671/dcad9216-12af-4494-ba86-d82f4cb52fee)

What Mocke will do is to run deep research into a lead, the business behind, their department and teams, and all relevant information with regard to what AI agent is selling. Then with the targeted deep research, AI agent will generate a highly-relevant email for one lead.

 Just to highlight, in the Pylon example above, there are various prompts:

* A paragraph prompt `[Write a short paragraph in 30 words or less. Ask the lead if their support team has experienced a large volume of support tickets in Q1 2026, and how they handle it. Must mention one specific technical product error message often asked by the lead's users. Must use deep technical terminology in the context of the lead's product. Must mention the lead's product name.]`
* A phrase prompt `[describe the lead's team, in 3 words or less]`

 So you can choose from full delegation to AI to write content, or partially if you want to have finer control over customization.

###  Step 3: Preview deep research and emails

To review the deep research and email writing, you can provide a lead's LinkedIn profile for the AI agent to conduct in-depth research and craft a personalized email in real-time. This ensures you feel confident about the dynamic content generated by the AI, based on the prompts embedded in the email templates.

 For this demo, I'm again using two potential leads of Pylon and have AI run deep research to write emails. You can compare them side-to-side to see the difference.

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98225&key=user_uploads/675671/4d2f6ca8-bda6-4264-bab1-295e51ba50c4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98225&key=user_uploads/675671/d773b48d-0501-4b35-83df-cb2364a6b508)

### Ready to launch

After completing the three steps in just 60 seconds, you can upload your list of leads. The AI agent will then conduct deep research and create personalized messages for each lead, one by one!

# 🚀🚀🚀 **Ask**

No sign-up is required, and it's free to use. Simply visit our website <https://mocke.co/> and enter your website. In just 60 seconds, you'll receive a cold email that you'll truly like.

My ask: try it out with your website and share your honest feedback. Let us know  whether you love it or not.

 

---

---

---

---

---

— — — —

---

# How it works underneath

If you are still reading and interested to know a little more.

### Email Writing Workflow

For each lead, Mocke would go through a few steps to write unique messaging per person and ensure it's relevant.

1. Build a profile of the lead by scraping LinkedIn page
2. Build a profile of the company of the lead by querying B2B databases
3. Use [@Firecrawl](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/27152) (shout out to the team, amazing product as well!) to crawl website and/or targeted information search using its agent
4. Use agentic loop to finish email writing, polishing, reviewing, scoring, and delivering

### What can be found in deep research?

1. Anything mentioned on main marketing website
2. Anything mentioned in documentation
3. Google searchable content if the results come back in the first page of SERP
4. Top reddit relevant threads (same reason as above, indexed by Google)
5. Personal and company LinkedIn profiles activities

### What if AI can't find information?

Mocke AI agent will not generate inaccurate information, as we have safeguards in place. In the case of information not found, AI will write generic content, rather than specific reference of information.

Hi everyone, we’re Evan and Jad — two Dartmouth grads building Verdex.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otKHPaRs-mQ>

### The Problem

Crop insurers worldwide spend over **$5 billion every year** on a single manual task: verification.

* Today, insurers cannot verify a claim without physically sending an adjuster to a field.
* This manual process is so slow and labor-intensive that it consumes nearly **10% of every premium dollar** collected globally.
* As extreme weather events increase, the volume of claims is skyrocketing, making the current adjuster model completely unscalable.

### The Solution

Verdex allows insurers to monitor every field on earth in real time.

* We combine high-resolution satellite imagery with local weather models to interpret field-level conditions with precision.
* Instead of waiting weeks for a field visit, insurers can verify the insured asset in seconds and settle the claim instantly. This means insurers aren’t scrambling to dispatch adjusters, and policyholders get paid on the spot.
* Last month, major regulators such as the USDA updated their guidelines to allow for satellite-based remote verification.

We are already live with one of the largest crop insurers in the US, helping them insure **100+ million acres** — that’s over **11% of all farmland** in the US. But insurance is more than just crops — our vision is to be the data and interpretability layer for any insurable asset you can see from space. \
**About Axis:**

We started building Axis on the belief that models could be incredibly powerful when applied to traded markets. 

This mainly came from our experience as traders. Trading is highly context driven, yet the majority of qualitative market information goes unparsed: real-world news, broker data, macro narratives, and more. This information is high-signal to a trader but unstructured. For the first time, LLMs provide an effective way of analyzing this information across multiple sources. 

**In Short:** _We believe models reveal what a trading system could be: not a data feed, but a tool that actively enhances a trader’s view of the market._

**Our first market: Commodities**

Commodities are real-world markets that make up the movement of energy, agricultural products, metals, chips, and more around the globe. They make up roughly a third of global goods exports. 

Commodities trading is a unique domain. Like equities, there are futures/options and other publicly traded derivatives that track commodities at the macro scale. This is where banks and hedge funds typically trade.

However, there is an entire separate group of “physical” commodities traders who are responsible for moving commodities (oil, grain, copper) to locations around the globe. Their “trading” is the original form of “trade”: transporting materials to another location, taking on storage and transportation risk, receiving a premium for the service. Oil companies like Shell and Chevron have large commodities trading units responsible for trading/hedging their supply.

These traders still operate like normal trading desks, hedging and speculating in public markets, but they are also responsible for deciding storage and transportation. They track the markets at a granular and varied scale: transportation logistics, regional demand/inventory, derivatives positioning, macro narratives, and more. 

**_Engaging in these markets is complicated and it’s where we think our models shine. Axis allows a commodities desk to deploy custom models for monitoring their strategy 24/7._**

**About Us:**\
We both worked in quantitative trading. We learned a lot. It’s showed us how varied “trading” can be and how markets are best approached.\
\
\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mKPQXt7nkkM>

launches.title: End Close: Solving payments reconciliation with AI Agents
launches.tagline: AI powered reconciliation at scale
launches.detail_body:
**TLDR**

End Close is building automatic reconciliation for payments companies, replacing manual ops work with AI agents that automatically investigate and resolve every exception.

Our team has 6 years of experience building systems to reconcile a trillion dollars annually.

<https://youtu.be/5xral3GHBVs>

**The Problem**

Every day, ops teams at payments companies spend hours manually investigating exceptions - transactions that didn't match, funds that can't be accounted for, discrepancies across banks, processors, and ledgers. Legacy reconciliation tools weren't built for this. They were designed for month-end close, not real-time fintech infrastructure. And the cost of getting it wrong is real: lost money, unreliable financials, and compliance exposure.

**The Solution**

End Close continuously ingests records from your banks, processors, and data warehouse - so exceptions are caught as soon as they arise, not weeks later during month-end close.

And unlike most reconciliation tools that only tell you something is wrong, our AI agent handles exceptions end-to-end before they have time to compound - pulling context from connected systems, finding the root cause, and resolving them without looping in your team. Hours of manual investigation become minutes of autonomous work, with full transparency into every decision.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98256&key=user_uploads/348419/736cf82d-73f6-460b-9223-a963e79187e9)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98256&key=user_uploads/348419/0bda9aa6-2278-40a3-9a62-86649664fbf0)

**About Us**

Sean and David are the co-founders of End Close.

Sean spent 6 years building the reconciliation org at Modern Treasury (S18) where he was the 2nd engineering hire, processing a trillion dollars in payments across 40 banks with 99.995% automation. He has built high volume ACH and Wire origination systems and is the primary contributor of the popular open-sourced LedgerSync library for integrating with legacy ERP providers.

David is a second time founder, having previously gone through YC S19 with Unflow, helped creators earn $100k+ selling live classes online during COVID. Since then he led the error tracking team at PostHog (W20). He was responsible for launching and growing the product to thousands of customers in its first 6 months, the fastest growing in the company’s history. He also has experience as a product engineer at Intercom and Basecamp

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98256&key=user_uploads/348419/a80251f9-c9b1-4dd7-933d-7b839bc0d243)

**Our Asks**

If you team is unhappy with legacy solutions like Blackline or your ops team is wasting time manually reconciling payments, [talk to us today](https://calendly.com/sean-endclose/end-close-book-a-demo)
